targets.label: Books to Scrape — Travel category
targets.fieldDescription: Extract every book in this category. For each book return four fields. name is the book title. sku is the UPC code shown on the book detail page. price is the numeric price with no currency symbol. availability is the stock status, normalised to exactly in_stock when the book is available or out_of_stock when it is not.
